entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about a pair of road cycling shoes I purchased a while back. I'd like to see about returning them.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-09B. I got them about two months ago.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered 63 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a fit and comfort issue. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but no matter what I do, they keep giving me terrible blisters after any ride longer than an hour. They're just not working for my feet, so I'd like to get a refund.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check our policy for you... one moment.

Alright, thank you for waiting. I've checked the policy, and since you received the item 63 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve that return for you.

Oh, that's great news. I appreciate that. Since I did have to go through the trouble of trying them out and now have to package them up and send them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'd like to try a different model.

I understand your position, and I'm glad we could get the return sorted out. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow for issuing discount codes on top of a full refund. However, I have just processed the return authorization and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. As soon as we receive the cycling shoes at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Okay, that's fair. As long as the refund is processed, I'm happy. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
